grammar.q: Howard can play baseball, but his sister ____.
grammar.tip: but 前後語意相反；can 句型→can't

grammar.q: Jolin is a nice girl. Don't fight with ____.
grammar.tip: Jolin 是女生；介系詞 with 後用受格 her

grammar.q:
Sandy: Can you swim?
Lucy: ____ But I can play basketball.
grammar.tip: But 表轉折→前面是「不會」→No, I can't.

grammar.q: Please ____ run in the classroom.
grammar.tip: 否定祈使句：Please don't + 原形

grammar.q: Ms. Lee is our teacher. She is very nice to ____.
grammar.tip: 介系詞 to 後用受格 us

grammar.q:
Students: Can we play cards in the classroom?
Teacher: No, ____.
grammar.tip: 學生問 we，老師答 you；否定用 can't

grammar.q: Robert and Larry are my cousins. I play with ____.
grammar.tip: 兩個人、在 with 後→受格 them

grammar.q: ____ my cat. ____ name is Mimi.
grammar.tip: It's = It is；Its = 牠的(所有格)

grammar.q: Don't read comic books ____ talk on the phone in class.
grammar.tip: 否定句連接兩個動作用 or

grammar.q: Be ____, please. Don't talk in class.
grammar.tip: 不要說話→Be quiet. 安靜

grammar.q: Where are you, Ben? I can't ____ you.
grammar.tip: 看不到你→see；can't + 原形

grammar.q: Jacky, come play ____ my dog, Lucky.
grammar.tip: 和…一起玩→play with

grammar.q: Wait, please. It's not your ____ now.
grammar.tip: turn（輪到的）機會；請等待

grammar.q:
Tom: The pictures are really beautiful.
Bill: Yes, ____. Let's look at them.
grammar.tip: pictures 複數→they；Yes 接肯定 are

grammar.q: These comic books are new. Please read ____ in the room.
grammar.tip: comic books 複數、在動詞後→them

grammar.q: Look at the ____. We can't eat or drink in the museum.
grammar.tip: 看標誌→sign

grammar.q:
Tom: ____
Bill: In the park. Follow me.
grammar.tip: 回答地點 In the park→問 Where

grammar.q: Hi! I'm Alan. The boy in front of ____ is Tom.
grammar.tip: 說話者是我；介系詞 of 後用受格 me

grammar.q: The boy is Tom, and the girl next to ____ is Judy.
grammar.tip: next to 後用受格；Tom 男生→him

grammar.q: Tom and Judy are nice to me, and I am happy to be ____ friends.
grammar.tip: 我是 Tom 和 Judy 的朋友→their

grammar.q: Tom, Judy, and I are classmates. ____ are good friends.
grammar.tip: Tom, Judy and I→主格 We

grammar.q: ____ talk in the museum, please.
grammar.tip: 否定祈使句用 Don't + 原形

grammar.q:
A: Let's ____ read comic books.
B: OK. Let's play basketball.
grammar.tip: Let's 否定→Let's not + 原形

grammar.q:
Bob: Can you jump rope?
Tom: Yes, I ____.
grammar.tip: 用 can 問就用 can 答

grammar.q:
A: What ____ your sister do?
B: She can sing and dance.
grammar.tip: 答句用 can→問句 What can…do?

grammar.q:
A: Can your mother cook?
B: No. But my father ____.
grammar.tip: my father can (cook)，省略重複動詞

grammar.q:
A: ____ can Judy do?
B: She can draw comics.
grammar.tip: 問「會做什麼」→What

grammar.q: Peter can ____ many things. He can cook, sing, and dance.
grammar.tip: can + 原形動詞 do

grammar.q: Please ____ nice to your classmates.
grammar.tip: 祈使句 be 動詞用原形 be

grammar.q: Let's ____.
grammar.tip: Let's + 原形；否定是 Let's not

grammar.q: ____, come here, ____.
grammar.tip: 稱謂, 祈使句, please.

grammar.q: Don't ____ in the lab.
grammar.tip: Don't + 原形動詞

grammar.q: Tom, ____ a good student. Your brother Tim ____ a good student.
grammar.tip: 祈使句用 be；Tim 單數用 is

grammar.q: Please ____ the cake. Let's ____ for Johnny.
grammar.tip: 先別吃，我們等 Johnny

grammar.q: Hello, I'm Mr. Hsieh. Please follow ____.
grammar.tip: 說話者是我；動詞後用受格 me

grammar.q: Ben and you are in the park. She can see ____.
grammar.tip: Ben and you→受格 you（你們）

grammar.q: My sister and I are at the museum. Please wait for ____.
grammar.tip: My sister and I→受格 us

grammar.q: The girls love their grandparents and play with ____.
grammar.tip: grandparents 複數→them

grammar.q:
Liam: I can play baseball. Can I play with ____ guys?
Lucas: Sure.
grammar.tip: with 後用受格；you guys 你們

grammar.q: ____ late for class.
grammar.tip: late 是形容詞要用 be；否定 Don't be

grammar.q: ____ be quiet. The teacher is not happy.
grammar.tip: 我們安靜吧→Let's + 原形

grammar.q: Let's ____ draw in our books. It's not nice.
grammar.tip: Let's not + 原形

grammar.q:
Mom: Jack, please ____ play with the ball in the living room.
Jack: OK.
grammar.tip: please don't + 原形

grammar.q: You can't use your phone in the lab. Please turn ____ off.
grammar.tip: phone 單數、動詞後→it；turn it off

grammar.q:
A: Is the man a police officer?
B: Yes, he is. Let's go talk to ____.
grammar.tip: 介系詞 to 後用受格 him

grammar.q: I can't see the sign from here. Can you read it for ____?
grammar.tip: 介系詞 for 後用受格 me

grammar.q:
A: ____ he cook?
B: Yes, he can.
grammar.tip: 簡答用 can→問句 Can he…?

grammar.q:
A: Can Yuki and Zac dance?
B: No, ____.
grammar.tip: 兩人→they；can 問 can't 答

grammar.q: Ken ____ swim, but he can play baseball.
grammar.tip: but 前後相反→can't + 原形

grammar.q:
A: What can you do?
B: ____
grammar.tip: What can you do? 答 I can + 原形

grammar.q: ____ careful, Yuki. It's a dinosaur!
grammar.tip: careful 是形容詞，祈使句用 Be

grammar.q: Kitty can ____ rope.
grammar.tip: can + 原形動詞

grammar.q: Look behind ____, Zac! It's a mummy.
grammar.tip: 介系詞 behind 後用受格 you

fix.tip: 祈使句 don't + 原形動詞
Let's 否定→Let's not + 原形
祈使句 be 動詞用原形 Be
用 can 問就用 can't 答

fix.t: My cousin [[can]] [[play]] baseball, and I play with [[he]] [[after class]].
Ms. Lee [[is]] nice to [[we]]. [[She]] [[is]] our teacher.
fix.tip: 介系詞 to 後用受格 us
否定句連接兩動作用 or

fix.t: [[Look]] at [[that]] sign. You [[can't]] [[using]] your phone here.

fix.tip: It's = It is；Its 是所有格
介系詞 next to 後用受格 me

fix.t: [[These]] [[comic books]] are new. Please read [[they]] in [[the]] room.

fix.tip: 介系詞 with 後用受格 them

fix.t:
A: Is the man [[a]] police officer?
B: Yes, [[he is]]. [[Let's]] go talk to [[he]].

fix.tip: 否定祈使句用 Don't + 原形
助動詞 can 不加 s
否定祈使句用 Don't + 原形

sent.en: With this door, we can go to many places.
sent.hl: With this door, we [[can go]] to many places.
o: 用這扇門，我們可以去很多地方。
用這扇門，我們不能去很多地方。
用這扇門，他們可以去很多地方。
Zac 會打開這扇魔法門。
sent.tip: 原形動詞開頭→命令、要求
us 是受格，是被看見的人

sent.en: Look! I can jump on these rocks.
o: 看！我可以在這些石頭上跳。
看！我可以在這塊石頭上跳。
看！我不能在這些石頭上跳。
不要吃東西，但可以喝飲料。
sent.tip: 否定句中的 or：兩樣都不要

sent.en: Can he cook? Yes, he can.
sent.tip: Yes, he can. 肯定簡答

sent.en: Can they jump rope? No, they can't.
o: 他們會跳繩嗎？不，他們不會。
他們會跳繩嗎？是的，他們會。
sent.tip: No, they can't. 否定簡答

sent.en: What can he do? He can cook.
o: 他會做什麼？他不會煮飯。

sent.en: Please follow these lab rules and be safe.
o: 請遵守那些實驗室規則並注意安全。
請遵守這條實驗室規則並注意安全。
請遵守這些實驗室規則並注意安全。

sent.en: Do not run in the lab.
o: 我們別在實驗室裡跑吧。

sent.tip: 原形動詞開頭；your 你的

sent.en: They are nice to me, and I am nice to them, too.
sent.hl: They are nice to [[me]], and I am nice to [[them]], too.
o: 他們對我很好，我也對她很好。
他們對我很好，我也對他們很好。
他們對你很好，你也對他們很好。

sent.en: Look at the sign. You can't eat here.
sent.hl: [[Look]] at the sign. You [[can't eat]] here.
o: 看那個標誌。你不能在這裡吃東西。
看那個標誌。你可以在這裡吃東西。
看那些標誌。你不能在這裡吃東西。

sent.tip: 原形動詞開頭；your 你的

sent.en: Please... no mummies or dinosaurs this time.
o: 拜託……這次要有木乃伊或恐龍。
拜託……這次不要有木乃伊，要有恐龍。
拜託……這次不要有木乃伊或恐龍。
sent.tip: 否定中的 or：兩樣都不要
